It samples 80% of the nodes. There are 10 nodes plus the client that just sent MEET, so we have 11.

wanted = 11 * 80 / 100 = 8

candidates_wanted = wanted + 2 = 10; /* +2 for myself and link->node */

So 10 out of 11 nodes are sampled. If myself and the peer are among the sampled nodes, we can get 8 nodes we can send gossip about. If either myself or the peer are not sampled, we get 9 nodes (all of the other nodes in the cluster) to gossip about. So count can at least be 8 and 9. I'm not
